subject: Runway sprint: consolidated account dossiers + final QBR pack
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-03-10 08:15 -0700
Subject: Runway sprint: consolidated account dossiers + final QBR pack

Team —

We’re three business days out from the QBR deck lock. Quick consolidation ask so we can hand off the final pack to Exec Review on Friday morning:

- Per-account one-pager (1 slide) for any account > $250k ARR. Focus: close plan, open risks, PO/contract status, required exec asks.
- Forecast lock: please mark the committed vs. best-case numbers in column E of the attached workbook (runway_account_rollup_v3.xlsx).
- Risk tags: "Procurement", "Technical Eval", "Budget", "Timeline" — add one per account and a 1‑line mitigation.

Specifics:
- Karthik: I need Atlas Health consolidated notes (including updated close date and procurement contact) by EOD Wednesday.
- Laura: can you confirm whether Finance saw the latest SOW (attached) and whether we can accelerate invoicing for March?
- Aditya: we’ll need your 1-paragraph readout for the leadership slide — high level asks + recommended concessions (if any).

Attachments: runway_account_rollup_v3.xlsx (master), atlas_mutual_action_plan.docx (draft MAP), pipeline_snapshot_atlas.csv (raw tokens).

Keep replies tight — I’ll compile and send the pre-read to Execs Thursday evening.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

On Sat, Mar 10, 2028 at 08:15 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We’re three business days out from the QBR deck lock...

Thanks — quick update on Atlas Health:

- Committed number: $320,000 ARR (moved from $280k) — sales execs moved some volume to Dedicated to meet latency SLA asks.
- Close plan: Legal + Procurement looped this week; PO expected week of Mar 20.
- Procurement contact: Natalie Cho (natalie.cho@atlashealth.com) — I spoke to her 3/11; she asked for a short MAP and revised SOW.
- Risks: Procurement (medium) — gap is audit-log retention; Technical Eval (low) — they asked about quantization profiles and both our dedicated and hosted fallbacks.

Attached: pipeline_snapshot_atlas.csv (updated), atlas_mutual_action_plan.docx (annotated).

I’ve populated the master sheet with committed vs best-case and moved Atlas close date to 2028-03-21 (probability 70%).

Karthik
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

> 
> - Committed number: $320,000 ARR...

Adding finance input: I confirmed with Tina in Billing that she has the latest SOW but finance needs the final MAP language to align invoicing milestones. If we want accelerated invoicing in March we need a signed SOW by 03/20 and a PO that references invoice schedule.

Also: flagged Atlas as "Procurement" risk — they requested our SOC2 evidence and TLS termination details. I pushed them the SOC2 redacted report and our network diagram link (see related_links). Procurement asked if we can accept a short amendment to net days (from 60 to 45) — not a blocker but worth Aditya's call-out.

Laura
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-13 11:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway sprint: consolidated account dossiers + final QBR pack

Thanks team — short leadership readout (for the slide):

- Atlas Health: Recommended move to "Committed" for $320k contingent on signed SOW and PO by 03/21.
- Ask: Approve a one-time 15-day reduction in net payment terms (Finance to sign off) to accelerate March invoicing and improve runway.
- Concessions: We will offer a single-month implementation credit (up to $12k) if procurement signs the MAP and provides PO within the week.

If Finance approves reduced terms, we classify Atlas as green with a conditional ask. Otherwise, it stays amber and we keep the best-case in the forecast.

Aditya
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
